minor.issue: Requires 'file:read' — fine, but viewer role can therefore create a public link exposing text/images they can only read. If that's intentional, ignore; otherwise gate on 'file:write' or 'member:manage'.

ui_bugs.issue: The share flow wraps navigator.clipboard.writeText() inside the same try/catch as the API call. In the sandboxed iframe/preview, clipboard.writeText often rejects with a Permissions-Policy or NotAllowedError, so users see a misleading 'Could not create share link' toast even though the /share POST returned 200 and the token was created. Split the two: on API success, call setShared+toast.success('Public link copied') if clipboard succeeds, else toast.info with the link visible for manual copy. Verified from backend logs: POST /share returns 200 while the UI still shows the error toast.

Backend sends the entire reply word-by-word after generating the FULL response (see /chat/.../stream endpoint: it awaits generate_text fully, then yields chunks with 20ms sleep). Consumer works, but it's not true streaming — user still waits for the whole LLM call before any delta arrives. This is a design/perf issue, not a functional bug. Consider `chat.send_message_stream` if available in the SDK.

action_items: Fix Creations.js share() to not show 'Could not create share link' when the /share POST succeeded but only clipboard.writeText failed. Show the link inline as a fallback so users can copy it manually in embedded/iframe previews.
Consider real token-level streaming for /chat/.../stream (current implementation waits for full LLM response then simulates streaming).
OPTIONAL: Reconsider whether 'viewer' role should be able to create public share tokens (currently share uses 'file:read').
critical_code_review_comments: studio/router.py _spend is now race-safe: atomic findOneAndUpdate with `credits: {'$gte': cost}` ensures no negative balances. Concurrent-debit test (6 parallel chat sends) confirmed: before-after equals number of 200s, no drift. Good.

studio/router.py gen_image with variations>1 still spends+refunds per iteration — if iter-2 hits 402 the caller silently receives fewer images than requested. Consider pre-charging n*COST['image'] atomically ($gte n*cost, $inc -n*cost) at the top.

studio/router.py chat_stream: calls await gateway.generate_text (which awaits the FULL reply) BEFORE opening the SSE StreamingResponse and then simulates streaming by splitting the completed reply. This works but negates the UX benefit of SSE — first token is not faster than the non-stream /send endpoint.
studio/router.py share_creation permission='file:read' allows viewers to create public share links to content they can only read.
llm/gateway.py generate_image now uses per-request uuid session id — good, resolves the earlier context-bleed concern.

llm/gateway.py web_search uses DuckDuckGo instant-answers API which returns only 'RelatedTopics' — for many queries this list is empty. Consider falling back to duckduckgo_search (HTML) if RelatedTopics is empty to guarantee sources for arbitrary queries.

studio/router.py _run_media_job: on failure, refund is called AFTER the async task started — this is correct, but the initial creation record already exists as 'failed' with an error field; consider surfacing a friendly message on the frontend polling loop (currently just toast.error('Video: ' + e)).
studio/router.py: /public/creations/{token} does not increment any view counter or expiry — links live forever. Fine for MVP; consider TTL/revoke UI later.

Frontend Chat.js: on SSE parse error the last two messages (user+assistant placeholder) are sliced away. If mid-stream network drops, partial assistant content is thrown away silently. Show a retry/regenerate button.

rca of the issue: UI 'Could not create share link' toast RCA: the share() function in /app/frontend/src/pages/Creations.js awaits api.post(.../share) AND navigator.clipboard.writeText(link) inside the SAME try block. In the Emergent preview iframe the clipboard API is blocked by Permissions-Policy (clipboard-write=self only), so writeText() rejects with NotAllowedError and the outer catch shows toast.error('Could not create share link') — even though the share was successfully created (backend logs show `POST .../share 200 OK` and the token is persisted). Fix: split the two concerns — after api.post success, ALWAYS setShared(true) + toast.success; wrap only clipboard.writeText in its own try/catch and, on failure, expose the link in a small popover/modal so the user can copy it manually.
